name: Ledgerler
summary: Bank and ledger reconciliation and month-end close for small businesses and bookkeepers. Its deterministic matching engine is a public HTTP API (POST /api/v1/match) that is free and keyless on the free tier (20 requests per hour per IP): send bank and ledger lines, get back matched groups each with a method and a confidence score, every unmatched line listed, and a summary with a match rate and the residual difference. Also a client-side browser tool and a month-end close checklist with sign-off and an audit trail (Pro). The site advertises 'MCP tools', but no MCP server was found.

agentAccess.notes: Measured keyless 2026-11-12 18:20Z: POST www.ledgerler.com/api/v1/match answered 200 with no signup or key (an access check only; it shows nothing about reconciliation quality). Free tier 20 req/hour/IP. No MCP server found at /mcp, /api/v1/mcp or /api/mcp (404 each; not proof none exists).

jobs.summary: Ledgerler documents a deterministic matching engine: POST /api/v1/match takes bank and ledger lines and returns matched groups (method + confidence), every unmatched line, and a summary with a match rate and difference. No aggregate match-rate, unreconciled-items or hours figure is published.

payments.notes: Free plan ($0): 1 entity, 2 accounts, 3 reconciliations/mo, 3 saved match rules, 1 close checklist, and the matching API. Pro ($29/mo, $290/yr) makes those five limits unlimited and adds CSV export and an audit trail. The pricing page names no payment method, so humanBilling is unknown.
